answers.explanation: It decides what's allowed. The quota-checking code would be the mechanism.
That's how the quota is enforced: a mechanism.
The timer is how the OS regains control.
How long to allow is a decision about what will be done.
The number of minutes is a choice. Locking the screen is the mechanism.
It's the means of changing priorities, whatever values a policy chooses.
Who may do what is policy.
It enforces whatever permissions are set.
That's the payoff of separating policy from mechanism.
